newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian among Peru rebels' hostages.
newsitem.headline: Belgian among Peru rebels' hostages.

text.p: A Belgian national representing the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) is among hundreds of hostages held in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, Peru, the Foreign Ministry in Brussels said on Thursday.
A spokesman named the man working for the Rome-based United Nations body as Jean-Francois Ghyoot. He have no details.

Leftist rebels have been holding up to 484 people including high-ranking diplomats, businessmen and government officials, since Tuesday. They are threatening to kill the hostages unless 400 to 500 jailed comrades are released.
